title: Google launches Gemini 4 Carbon with cybersecurity focus
dek: Gemini 4 Carbon is Google’s newest frontier model; Google says it leads a key benchmark and improves coding, agentic tasks, and cybersecurity.
body:
Google released Gemini 4 Carbon, its newest frontier model, and said the model delivers “significant gains” in coding, agentic tasks, and cybersecurity. The company announced the release on Wednesday and highlighted Carbon’s top ranking on a public benchmark.

## Why it matters

Google is positioning Carbon as an advance in areas that matter to enterprises and developers: code generation, agentic tasks (tasks where a model plans and executes multi-step actions), and cybersecurity. Google also emphasized Carbon’s benchmark performance, which matters because benchmarks influence how companies and developers compare models when choosing providers or building products.

## The details

- Google announced Gemini 4 Carbon on Wednesday as its latest frontier model—Google’s top-tier model class.
- Google described Carbon as showing “significant gains” in coding, agentic tasks, and cybersecurity.
- Google said Gemini 4 Carbon holds the top spot on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index (v5.0) benchmark.
- Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra were listed as trailing Carbon on that benchmark.
- The announcement framed cybersecurity as a prominent area of improvement for Carbon.

Several specifics were not disclosed in the material available: Google did not publish detailed benchmark numbers in the announcement covered, precise architectural changes or model size, exact latency or cost metrics, or which cybersecurity evaluations were used to support the claim.

## What to watch

Watch for independent evaluations and published benchmark scores that show how Carbon compares to Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra across multiple tasks. Also watch for technical papers, white papers, or blog posts from Google that detail the model’s architecture, safety testing, and cybersecurity evaluation methods.

Source: [The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/tech/1021339/google-gemini-4-carbon-cybersecurity-frontier)
